1.plot: 十三岁的杰米在家中被逮捕，罪名是杀害一名同学。四集分别跟着拘捕、学校、心理评估和这个家庭的余波，每一集都是一个不中断的长镜头。
1.plotEn: Thirteen-year-old Jamie is arrested at home, accused of killing a classmate. The four episodes follow the arrest, the school, a psychological evaluation, and the aftermath for the family. Each episode is one uninterrupted shot.
1.playbill: 每集一镜到底，四集讲一个 13 岁男孩被控谋杀后的四个时刻。它关注网络厌女文化怎样影响青少年，以及父母和学校为什么没有察觉。第一次演戏的欧文·库珀在第三集与心理医生的对手戏尤其惊人。
1.playbillEn: Each episode is a single take. Four episodes cover four moments after a 13-year-old boy is charged with murder. It is about how online misogyny reaches teenagers, and why the parents and the school did not see it. Owen Cooper, acting for the first time, is especially startling in the third episode, opposite the psychologist.

2.plot: 在《侠盗一号》之前，卡西恩·安多还不是叛军英雄。他被卷进偷窃、监狱和一场需要账本、演讲和牺牲才能运转的革命。
2.plotEn: Before Rogue One, Cassian Andor is not yet a rebel hero. He is pulled into a theft, a prison, and a revolution that runs on ledgers, speeches, and sacrifice.
2.playbill: 《星球大战》衍生剧，但几乎不靠绝地武士和原力，讲的是普通人怎样被逼上反抗之路。政治、监狱和谍报线都写得很成熟，不看其他星战作品也能看懂。第一季的监狱篇是全剧高峰，第二季结尾直接接上电影《侠盗一号》。
2.playbillEn: A Star Wars series that barely relies on Jedi or the Force. It is about ordinary people being pushed into resistance. The politics, the prison, and the spycraft are written for adults, and you can follow it without the other films. The prison stretch of the first season is the high point. The end of the second season runs straight into Rogue One.

3.plot: 一对一起做实验的高中校友守着一个秘密：其中之一的Marshall发现了全世界最厉害的药物，是一种可以治愈几乎一切病痛的蘑菇。但是，要将它介绍给全世界是非常艰难的：美国缉毒局、大型制药公司和国际上的商人们都想阻止其面市。
3.plotEn: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

4.plot: 改编自莫莉·科汉的真实故事，最初在她与挚友妮基·博耶共同创作的Wondery旗下播客中分享。莫莉在被诊断出罹患第四期转移性乳癌后决定离开丈夫史蒂夫，首次探索自身多样且复杂的性渴望。在好友妮基的支持与陪伴下，她鼓起勇气踏上这场冒险，而妮基也始终陪伴在她身边，直到生命的最后一刻。
4.plotEn: After Molly Kochan receives a diagnosis of Stage IV metastatic breast cancer, she leaves her husband and explores the full breadth and complexity of her sexual desires for the first time in her life.

5.plot: 少年重逢的两位童年好友坠入爱河，经历着初恋情愫带来的甜蜜与伤痛，这段感情将永远改变他们的人生。该剧改编自1975年朱迪·布鲁姆笔下的知名小说，讲述一段梦幻的现代爱情故事。
5.plotEn: Reunited as teens, childhood friends Keisha and Justin fall deeply in love, experiencing the joy and heartache of a first romance that will change their lives forever.

6.plot: 该剧以职业冰球联赛为背景，改编自Rachel Reid的同名小说，讲述了肖恩·霍兰德与伊利亚·罗扎诺夫长达八年的复杂关系；两人自17岁相识后，在赛场屡次交锋对抗，私下却因隐秘情愫陷入纠结，最终不得不在竞技荣耀与禁忌情感间作出抉择的故事。
6.plotEn: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.

7.plot: 该剧讲述了贝尼托·墨索里尼的早期职业生涯：从1919年创建意大利法西斯组织到1924年暗杀政治家贾科莫·马特奥蒂。
7.plotEn: Benito Mussolini's early career from his founding of the Fasci Italiani in 1919 up to the assassination of socialist politician Giacomo Matteotti in 1924 and his speech in Parliament on 3 January 1925.

8.plot: 天文学家发现神秘信号后，一种外星病毒迅速感染人类，将绝大多数人连接成共享意识的“联合体”。小说家卡萝尔·斯图尔卡却对病毒免疫，成为少数保持独立意识的人，并试图阻止全人类被“幸福”彻底同化。
8.plotEn: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

9.plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
9.plotEn: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
9.playbill: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
9.playbillEn: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

10.plot: 菲尔德为真人建造等比例的场景，让他们把一场艰难的谈话先排练一遍。计划越做越完整，最后连他自己的生活也被放进彩排。
10.plotEn: Fielder builds full-scale sets for real people so they can rehearse a difficult conversation first. The plan gets more complete, until his own life is put into the rehearsal.
10.playbill: 内森·菲尔德帮普通人「彩排」人生中的关键时刻，比如向朋友坦白一个谎言，为此不惜搭出一比一的酒吧场景。节目越往后越失控，连他自己也被卷了进去。好笑、诡异，也会让人不安。
10.playbillEn: Nathan Fielder helps ordinary people “rehearse” a crucial moment, such as confessing a lie to a friend, and will build a one-to-one copy of a bar to do it. As the show goes on it gets out of control, and he himself is pulled in. Funny, eerie, and unsettling.

11.plot: 酒吧里的喜剧演员唐尼对一名女顾客释放了善意，对方开始长期跟踪他。剧情随后转向唐尼自己隐瞒多年的受侵害经历，以及他为何没有立刻切断这段关系。
11.plotEn: Donny, a comedian working in a bar, offers a kindness to a woman at the bar, and she begins stalking him for a long time. The story then turns to the abuse Donny has hidden for years, and to why he did not cut the relationship off at once.
11.playbill: 根据理查德·加德的真实经历改编：一个失意的喜剧演员被一个女人长期跟踪骚扰。前半段像惊悚剧，后半段揭开他过去遭受性侵的创伤，非常沉重。表演极真实，杰西卡·甘宁演的跟踪者让人难忘。
11.playbillEn: Based on Richard Gadd’s own experience: a struggling comedian is stalked by a woman. The first half plays like a thriller. The second half uncovers the sexual abuse in his past, and it is very heavy. The performances feel real. Jessica Gunning’s stalker stays with you.

12.plot: 透过富有内省与奇幻色彩的故事，胡里奥·托雷斯展开了一场寻回遗失的金牡蛎耳环的心灵探索之旅。
12.plotEn: Julio Torres spins a fantastical tale of when he lost a gold oyster earring. In his search to find the precious object, Julio reflects on the offbeat characters he encounters in introspective, often eerie, and always comedic vignettes set in a dreamy, alternate version of New York City.

13.plot: 这部迷你剧讲述了一个作家的一个夏天发生的事件，这个家庭意外地获得了一处偏远的庄园，里面住满了不寻常的居民，他必须决定如何处理这座破旧的庄园。八集中发生了令人兴奋和喜剧的事件，未来的作家 Anšlavs Eglitis 与他的兄弟 Vidvuds、父亲 Viktors 和他的妻子 Hilda Vīka 一起开始修复庄园，同时开设一所寄宿处，它成为附近地区、过去的鬼魂、来自城市的游客和 1920 年代拉脱维亚拉脱维亚知识分子的交汇点和夏季舞台。
13.plotEn: A miniseries about the events during one summer in a family of a writer who are unexpectedly granted a remote estate with all  its unusual inhabitants, and who has to decide what to do with the dilapidated estate. Exciting and comic events in eight episodes in which the future writer Anšlavs Eglītis together with his brother Vidvuds, father Viktors and his wife Hilda Vīka, begin the restoration of the estate, at the same time opening a boarding house, which becomes the intersection and summer stage of the neighbourhood, ghosts of the past, visitors from the city and Latvian intellectuals in Latvia in the 1920s.

14.plot:
《天才雷普利》是一部 1999 年美国心理惊悚片，由安东尼·明格拉编剧和导演，改编自帕特里夏·海史密斯 1955 年的小说。该片以 20 世纪 50 年代为背景，由马特·达蒙 (Matt Damon) 饰演汤姆·雷普利 (Tom Ripley)，他是一名美国骗子，被派往意大利说服富有且被宠坏的花花公子迪基·格林利夫 (裘德·洛饰) 回国。然而，里普利对他和他的生活方式产生了危险的依恋。格温妮丝·帕特洛、凯特·布兰切特和菲利普·塞默·霍夫曼担任配角。这是继 1960 年法语电影《紫色正午》之后，海史密斯小说的第二次改编。
《才华横溢的雷普利先生》于 1999 年 12 月 12 日在福克斯布鲁因剧院首映，随后于 1999 年 12 月 25 日由派拉蒙影业在美国发行，米拉麦克斯国际公司在其他地区发行。这部电影获得了评论界和商业上的成功，全球票房收入为 1.288 亿美元，预算为 4000 万美元。它获得了五项奥斯卡金像奖提名，包括最佳改编剧本和最佳男配角提名。
14.plotEn:
The Talented Mr. Ripley is a 1999 American psychological thriller film written and directed by Anthony Minghella, based on Patricia Highsmith's 1955 novel. Set in the 1950s, it stars Matt Damon as Tom Ripley, an American con artist sent to Italy to convince Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law), a rich and spoiled playboy, to return home. However, Ripley becomes dangerously attached to him and his lifestyle. Gwyneth Paltrow, Cate Blanchett, and Philip Seymour Hoffman appear in supporting roles. This is the second adaptation of Highsmith's novel, following the 1960 French-language film Purple Noon.
The Talented Mr. Ripley premiered at Fox Bruin Theater on December 12, 1999 before being released by Paramount Pictures in the United States on December 25, 1999, with Miramax International releasing in other territories. The film was a critical and commercial success, grossing $128.8 million worldwide against a $40 million budget. It received five Academy Award nominations, including Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Supporting Actor for Law.

15.plot: 当莫妮卡决定挽救婚姻时，她求助于夫妻治疗师，却没有意识到她正是前一天晚上与丈夫大卫发生外遇的人。除了参加治疗之外别无选择，大卫开始生活在难以维持的谎言中，而莫妮卡必须隐藏她的鬼魂和财务欺诈风格，同时努力保持她的坚定、她的客户以及他们的两个儿子迭戈和盖尔的关系，这对双胞胎儿子不断陷入麻烦。
15.plotEn: When Monica decides to save her marriage, she turns to a couples therapist, unaware that she is precisely the person with whom her husband, David, had an affair the night before. With no other option than to have to attend the therapy, David begins to live a lie that is difficult to maintain, while Monica must hide her ghosts, financial fraud style, all while trying to keep her firm, her clients, and their relationship afloat for their two sons, Diego and Gael, twins who keep getting into trouble.

16.plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
16.plotEn: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
16.playbill: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
16.playbillEn: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

17.plot: 威廉王子在著名的希勒卡寄宿学校适应他的新生活，但事实证明，追随自己的内心比想象中更具挑战性。
17.plotEn: Prince Wilhelm adjusts to life at his prestigious new boarding school, Hillerska, but following his heart proves more challenging than anticipated.

18.plot: 自创立以来被誉为日本高级酒店的象征，是业界领先的老牌酒店柏拉图。但是，随着竞争的加剧，它的管理恶化了。客流量也下降，员工士气也下降。作为这样凋零的柏拉图的总经理，有一天会聘请一名男子。男人的名字是三枝克明(Dean Fujika)。作为酒店经营的专业人士，出现在国内外不佳的酒店，被传闻为其整理、出售助一臂之力的俗称“酒店怪人”。在上任短短几个月的时间里，反复神出鬼没出现在不同部门和服务现场，如接待部、餐厅和婚礼部门，将实践切入敏锐的业务改进。员工发出了反对的声音，柏拉图被混乱的漩涡所吞噬。但是他有隐藏的秘密和很大的另一个目的…
18.plotEn: Set in the present era of intensified hotel competition and depicts the decline and crisis of Hotel Platon.

19.plot: 这部纪录片系列提供了前所未有的机会了解洛杉矶县消防局的内部运作，记录真实的电话和真实的戏剧，同时向那些以服务的名义冒着生命危险的热情消防员们展示他们的面孔。这些现实生活中的英雄和他们引人入胜的故事与他们在生死前线面临的不可预测的危险一起被讲述。
19.plotEn: This docuseries offers unprecedented access to the inner workings of the Los Angeles County Fire Department, documenting real calls and real drama while giving faces to the passionate firefighters who risk their lives in the name of service. These real-life heroes and their compelling stories are told alongside the unpredictable dangers they face on the front lines of life and death.

20.plot: 陪审员罗纳德·格拉登参加一场美国陪审团审判，却不知道整起案件都是精心设计的骗局，除他之外，法官、律师、证人及其他陪审员全由演员扮演。
20.plotEn: The inner workings of an American jury trial through the eyes of one particular juror, Ronald Gladden. Gladden is unaware the entire case is fake, everyone except him is an actor and everything that happens — inside the courtroom and out — is carefully planned.

21.plot: 俄克拉何马保留地上的四个原住民少年打算离开这里，去加州。一个朋友的死让出走变成未完成的心愿，社区里的长辈则不断把他们拉回具体的生活。
21.plotEn: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma plan to leave for California. A friend’s death turns the leaving into an unfinished wish, and the elders in the community keep pulling them back into the specifics of a life.
21.playbill: 四个原住民少年在俄克拉何马的保留地偷东西攒钱，想去加州完成死去朋友的心愿。编剧、导演和主要演员几乎都是原住民，幽默里带着一点魔幻。三季完结，越往后越动人。
21.playbillEn: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma steal to save money. They want to go to California and finish a dead friend’s wish. The writers, directors, and principal cast are almost all Indigenous. The humor has a little of the supernatural in it. Three seasons, and it ends. It gets more moving as it goes.

22.plot: 山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，觉得自己是这里的外人。一个合唱团和朋友乔尔让她重新开口唱歌，也重新学习怎么待在一个小镇里。
22.plotEn: After her sister dies, Sam stays in her hometown in Kansas and feels like an outsider there. A choir and her friend Joel get her singing again, and get her learning how to stay in a small town.
22.playbill: 中年女人山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，一直找不到归属感，直到加入一群小镇「边缘人」的歌唱聚会。节奏慢，没有大反转，但写友情和孤独非常温柔。布里吉特·埃弗里特开口唱歌的段落很动人。
22.playbillEn: Sam, a middle-aged woman, stays in her Kansas hometown after her sister’s death and cannot find a place she belongs, until she joins a singing group of the town’s outsiders. It is slow, with no big reversal, and it is very gentle about friendship and loneliness. The passages where Bridget Everett sings are moving.

23.plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
23.plotEn: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
23.playbill: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
23.playbillEn: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

24.plot: 在现代文明被摧毁的二十年后，人类因现代传染病而面临绝种危机，幸存的人类为了生存自相残杀。中年男性走私犯乔尔（佩德罗·帕斯卡饰）为了完成“火萤”组织首领玛琳（梅尔·丹德里奇饰）的托付，带着14岁少女艾莉（贝拉·拉姆齐饰）一同踏出由军队保护的疫情隔离区，穿越化为废墟丛林的大都会。面对病毒感染变种人类与其他幸存者集团威胁，展开了一场改变两人一生的深刻旅程。
24.plotEn: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

25.plot: 一群敬业、热情的老师和一位略显失聪的校长聚集在费城的一所公立学校，决心帮助学生在生活中取得成功。
25.plotEn: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don’t love the school district’s less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

26.plot: 在《侠盗一号》之前，卡西恩·安多还不是叛军英雄。他被卷进偷窃、监狱和一场需要账本、演讲和牺牲才能运转的革命。
26.plotEn: Before Rogue One, Cassian Andor is not yet a rebel hero. He is pulled into a theft, a prison, and a revolution that runs on ledgers, speeches, and sacrifice.
26.playbill: 《星球大战》衍生剧，但几乎不靠绝地武士和原力，讲的是普通人怎样被逼上反抗之路。政治、监狱和谍报线都写得很成熟，不看其他星战作品也能看懂。第一季的监狱篇是全剧高峰，第二季结尾直接接上电影《侠盗一号》。
26.playbillEn: A Star Wars series that barely relies on Jedi or the Force. It is about ordinary people being pushed into resistance. The politics, the prison, and the spycraft are written for adults, and you can follow it without the other films. The prison stretch of the first season is the high point. The end of the second season runs straight into Rogue One.

27.plot: 厄恩辍学回到亚特兰大，替表兄、说唱歌手纸男孩管理刚起步的事业。城市、种族和名气在这里都不按常理出牌，有的集干脆走进另一个类型。
27.plotEn: Earn drops out and comes back to Atlanta to manage the early career of his cousin, the rapper Paper Boi. The city, race, and fame do not behave as expected here, and some episodes simply walk into another genre.
27.playbill: 表面讲穷小子给当说唱歌手的表弟做经纪人，实际每一集风格都可能不同：有时是荒诞喜剧，有时像恐怖片。它写美国黑人生活很独特，不说教，却处处刺人。第二季的《泰迪·珀金斯》一集尤其出名。
27.playbillEn: On the surface, a broke young man manages his cousin, a rapper. In practice each episode can be a different kind of show: sometimes an absurd comedy, sometimes something like a horror film. It writes Black life in America in its own way, without lectures, and it keeps pricking. The second-season episode “Teddy Perkins” is the one people single out.

28.plot: 关系密切的加维姐妹们一直以来互相关照。当她们其中一位的老公突然死亡，他的人寿保险公司为了证明恶意杀人动机的存在而展开了调查，并将怀疑目标锁定一众姐妹，因为她们都有充足理由杀死他。
28.plotEn: The tight-knit Garvey sisters have always looked out for one another. But when the toxic brother-in-law they all wanted dead actually dies, it turns their lives upside down and tests their bond like nothing before.

29.plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
29.plotEn: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
29.playbill: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
29.playbillEn: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

30.plot: 《Los Espookys》是一部美国西班牙语喜剧电视连续剧，由胡利奥·托雷斯、安娜·法布雷加和弗雷德·阿米森创作，并与贝尔纳多·贝拉斯科和卡桑德拉·钱格罗蒂一起主演。该剧讲述了一群朋友试图将他们对恐怖的热爱变成一项成功的事业，他们的大部分工作包括编造恐怖电影般的场景并欺骗人们认为它们是真实的。 《Los Espookys》于 2019 年 6 月 14 日在 HBO 首播。 2019年7月，该剧续订第二季，并于2022年9月16日首播。2022年12月，该剧在两季后被取消。 Los Espookys 荣获 2022 年皮博迪奖。
30.plotEn: Los Espookys is an American Spanish-language comedy television series created by Julio Torres, Ana Fabrega, and Fred Armisen, who also star alongside Bernardo Velasco and Cassandra Ciangherotti. The series follows a group of friends trying to turn their love of horror into a successful business, where most of their jobs consist of fabricating horror film-like situations and tricking people into thinking they are real. Los Espookys premiered on June 14, 2019, on HBO. In July 2019, the series was renewed for a second season which premiered on September 16, 2022. In December 2022, the series was canceled after two seasons. Los Espookys won a 2022 Peabody Award.

31.plot:
《花样年华》（繁体中文：花样年华；简体中文：花样年华；字面意思是“花样年华”、“花样年华”）是一部由王家卫编剧、导演和制作的 2000 年浪漫剧情片。该片由香港和法国联合制作，讲述了 1962 年一对男女（张曼玉饰）发现自己的配偶有外遇的故事。当他们在一起度过一段时间时，他们逐渐对彼此产生了感情。这是非正式三部曲中的第二部，前作是《狂野岁月》（1990 年），之后是《2046》（2004 年）。 
该片在第53届戛纳电影节正式竞赛单元首映，获得好评。梁振英荣获最佳男主角奖，成为首位获此殊荣的香港演员。 《花样年华》被选为第 73 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳国际故事片香港角逐，但并未获得提名。它经常被列为有史以来最伟大的电影之一，也是亚洲电影的主要作品之一。
31.plotEn:
In the Mood for Love (traditional Chinese: 花樣年華; simplified Chinese: 花样年华; lit. 'Flower-like Years', 'the prime of one's youth') is a 2000 romantic drama film written, directed, and produced by Wong Kar-wai. An international co-production between Hong Kong and France, the film follows a man (Tony Leung) and a woman (Maggie Cheung) in 1962 who discover that their spouses are having an affair. As they spend time together, they gradually develop feelings for one another. It is the second installment in an informal trilogy, preceded by Days of Being Wild (1990) and followed by 2046 (2004). 
The film premiered in the official competition at the 53rd Cannes Film Festival, where it received acclaim. Leung won the Best Actor award, becoming the first Hong Kong actor to receive the honour. In the Mood for Love was selected as Hong Kong's submission for Best International Feature Film at the 73rd Academy Awards, though it was not nominated. It is often listed as one of the greatest films of all time and one of the major works of Asian cinema.

32.plot: 《性 / 生活》讲述了一个女人、她的丈夫以及她的旧情人之间的三角恋故事，采用全新的视角审视了女性的身份和欲望。比莉·康纳利（莎拉·夏希饰）并非生来就是生活在郊区的全职妻子和母亲。在嫁给充满爱心且为人可靠的库伯（迈克·沃格尔饰）并搬到康涅狄格州之前，比莉是一个自由奔放的野孩子。她与好朋友莎夏（玛格丽特·奥黛特饰）一起在纽约生活，工作努力，玩得更嗨。照顾两个年幼的孩子让比莉感到筋疲力尽并开始怀念过去，于是她开始写日记，幻想自己与性感的前男友布莱德（亚当·迪莫斯饰）的激情之旅 — 与后者的分手让她一直无法释怀。但比莉越是回想，就越想不通自己为何走到了今天的地步。然后，丈夫发现了她的日记。有关比莉过去的真相会在她的婚姻中引发一场性革命吗？还是会让她与那个抛弃她并让她心碎的男人再续前缘？
32.plotEn: A woman's daring sexual past collides with her married-with-kids present when the bad-boy ex she can't stop fantasizing about crashes back into her life.

33.plot: 卢蒙公司的员工接受手术，把工作记忆和生活记忆切开。电梯下行之后，另一个自己开始上班，并且不想永远留在楼里。
33.plotEn: Employees of Lumon accept a procedure that splits work memory from life memory. After the elevator goes down, another self starts the shift, and does not want to stay in the building forever.
33.playbill: 公司员工通过手术把工作记忆和生活记忆分开，上班的自己不知道下班的自己是谁。设定新奇，复古冷色的办公室美术辨识度极高。悬念层层推进，第一季结尾非常抓人。本·斯蒂勒执导了第一季的大部分剧集。
33.playbillEn: A company’s employees undergo a procedure that separates the memory of work from the memory of life. The self at work does not know who the self at home is. The premise is new, and the retro, cold-colored office design is immediately recognizable. The mysteries stack up. The end of the first season grabs you. Ben Stiller directed most of the first season.

34.plot: 洛杉矶中心出现了巨大陷坑，上百个民众和大大小小的建筑都掉入洞中，也开启了一段传奇冒险。掉入洞中的人们发现自己来到了一个神秘又危险的史前世界，众人得互相合作才能生存。而在地表上的人则努力想厘清到底发生了什么事。现在，一个因这场悲剧遭拆散的家庭，得想办法解开一切的谜团，才能再次让家人团聚。
34.plotEn: An epic adventure begins when a massive sinkhole opens in the middle of Los Angeles, pulling hundreds of people and buildings into its depths. Those who fell in find themselves in a mysterious and dangerous primeval land, where they have no choice but to band together to survive. Meanwhile, the rest of the world desperately seeks to understand what happened. In the search for answers, one family torn apart by this disaster will have to unlock the secrets of this inexplicable event to find a way back to each other.

35.plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
35.plotEn: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
35.playbill: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
35.playbillEn: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

36.plot: 俄克拉何马保留地上的四个原住民少年打算离开这里，去加州。一个朋友的死让出走变成未完成的心愿，社区里的长辈则不断把他们拉回具体的生活。
36.plotEn: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma plan to leave for California. A friend’s death turns the leaving into an unfinished wish, and the elders in the community keep pulling them back into the specifics of a life.
36.playbill: 四个原住民少年在俄克拉何马的保留地偷东西攒钱，想去加州完成死去朋友的心愿。编剧、导演和主要演员几乎都是原住民，幽默里带着一点魔幻。三季完结，越往后越动人。
36.playbillEn: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma steal to save money. They want to go to California and finish a dead friend’s wish. The writers, directors, and principal cast are almost all Indigenous. The humor has a little of the supernatural in it. Three seasons, and it ends. It gets more moving as it goes.

37.plot:
《Sort Of》是一部加拿大喜剧电视剧，将于 2021 年在 CBC 电视台播出。该剧由 Zaiba Baig 和 Fab Filippo 创作，Baig 饰演 Sabi Mehboob，一名非二元千禧一代，试图平衡自己的角色：巴基斯坦移民父母的孩子、LGBTQ 书店和咖啡馆的调酒师以及职业夫妇年幼孩子的保姆。
该剧在加拿大的 CBC Television 和 CBC Gem 以及美国的 HBO Max 播出，共播出三季。该剧获得了评论家的积极评价，并成为第十届加拿大银幕奖提名最多的电视剧。该剧曾两次获得加拿大银幕奖最佳喜剧系列奖，并获得皮博迪奖。
2023年10月，宣布第三季也将是最后一季。第三季于 11 月 17 日在 CBC 播出，最后一集于 12 月 8 日发布。
37.plotEn:
Sort Of is a Canadian comedy drama television series, released on CBC Television beginning in 2021. Created by Zaiba Baig and Fab Filippo, the series stars Baig as Sabi Mehboob, a non-binary millennial trying to balance their roles as a child of Pakistani immigrant parents, a bartender at an LGBTQ bookstore and café, and a caregiver to the young children of a professional couple.
The show aired on CBC Television and CBC Gem in Canada and on HBO Max in the U.S., and ran for three seasons. The series received positive reviews from critics and was the most-nominated television series at the 10th Canadian Screen Awards. The show has won Best Comedy Series at the Canadian Screen Awards twice and won a Peabody Award.
In October 2023, it was announced that the third season would also be the last. Season three started broadcasting on November 17 on CBC and the final episode was released on December 8.

38.plot:
《地下铁道》是一部美国历史魔幻现实主义电视剧迷你剧，由巴里·詹金斯根据科尔森·怀特海德 2016 年的同名小说创作并执导。该剧于 2021 年 5 月 14 日在 Amazon Prime Video 上首播。
该剧荣获金球奖最佳限定剧或选集剧集或电视电影奖、英国电影学院奖最佳国际节目奖、皮博迪奖，并获得其他多项提名，包括黄金时段艾美奖杰出限定剧或选集剧集奖。
38.plotEn:
The Underground Railroad is an American historical magical realism drama television miniseries created and directed by Barry Jenkins based on the 2016 novel of the same name by Colson Whitehead. The series premiered on Amazon Prime Video on May 14, 2021.
The series won the Golden Globe Award for Best Limited or Anthology Series or Television Film, the BAFTA for Best International Programme, received a Peabody Award, and garnered several other nominations including the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Limited or Anthology Series.

39.plot: 两位好朋友，一位傻傻的只会学习，另一位学渣喜欢学霸但是不敢表白…
39.plotEn: Trong Nghia and Nhat Minh have been close friends since childhood, but suddenly one day Trong Nghia realized that he had different feelings for his best friend. Will Trong Nghia reveal this feeling or decide to keep silent to protect the long-standing friendship? -- Prequel of "You are my Sunshine" and "You are my stupid boy".

40.plot: 威廉王子在著名的希勒卡寄宿学校适应他的新生活，但事实证明，追随自己的内心比想象中更具挑战性。
40.plotEn: Prince Wilhelm adjusts to life at his prestigious new boarding school, Hillerska, but following his heart proves more challenging than anticipated.

41.plot: 作家阿拉贝拉在一个晚上被下药、侵害，之后她要靠碎片把那晚重新拼起来。朋友、约会和创作都不再能用原来的说法解释。
41.plotEn: The writer Arabella is drugged and assaulted one night, and afterward has to put that night back together from fragments. Friends, dates, and the work can no longer be explained in the old way.
41.playbill: 米凯拉·科尔根据自己被性侵的经历创作，她编剧、主演，也参与导演。题材沉重，但剧本不按受害者模板写：有幽默，有复杂的友情，也有模糊的道德问题。共 12 集，后劲很大，科尔凭此拿下艾美编剧奖。
41.playbillEn: Michaela Coel made it from her own sexual assault. She wrote it, stars in it, and directed some of it. The subject is heavy, and the script does not follow a victim template: there is humor, a complicated friendship, and moral questions that stay unclear. Twelve episodes. It stays with you. Coel won the Emmy for writing.

42.plot: 通过组成《小斧子》系列的《红树林》《情人摇滚》《红、白与蓝》《亚历克斯·惠特尔》《教育》五部影片，史蒂夫·麦奎因导演勾勒出一幅1960年代末至80年代初伦敦西印度裔生活的丰沛图景——对那个社群而言，那是一个由警察暴力的阴影、政治觉醒的赋权力量，以及蓬勃雷鬼音乐带来的狂喜慰藉所定义的时代。这些情感张力在温柔印象与冷峻洞察之间流动的影像，凭借演员的强力演绎，描绘出关于黑人抗争、欢愉、创造与集体行动的动人肖像——所有画面皆由夏比尔·基什纳以饱满视觉呈现——共同构筑了二十世纪中期英国转型时刻的一部革命性另类历史。[标准收藏]
42.plotEn: An anthology series of five stories looking at the lives of a group of friends and their families in London’s West Indian community from the late 1960s to the early 80s.

43.plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
43.plotEn: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
43.playbill: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
43.playbillEn: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.

44.plot: 在北卡罗来纳州一座贫富分明的小岛上，小约翰和三位密友前去寻找失落的宝藏，并经历了谜团和冒险。
44.plotEn: On a North Carolina island of haves and have-nots, John B and his tight-knit crew of friends find mystery and adventure while hunting for lost treasure.

45.plot:
《非正统》是一部德国剧情电视迷你剧，于 2020 年 3 月 26 日在 Netflix 首播。该剧受到黛博拉·费尔德曼 2012 年自传《非正统：对我的哈西德根源的丑闻拒绝》的启发，是第一部主要以意第绪语为主的 Netflix 剧集。这部四集迷你剧由安娜·温格和亚历克萨·卡罗林斯基创作和编剧，玛丽亚·施拉德执导。
该剧获得八项黄金时段艾美奖提名，包括最佳限定剧、最佳限定剧女主角（希拉·哈斯）和最佳限定剧编剧（安娜·温格），并荣获最佳限定剧导演奖（玛丽亚·施拉德）——这是德国制作的首个黄金时段艾美奖。
45.plotEn:
Unorthodox is a German drama television miniseries that debuted on Netflix on March 26, 2020. Inspired by Deborah Feldman's 2012 autobiography, Unorthodox: The Scandalous Rejection of My Hasidic Roots, it is the first Netflix series to be primarily in Yiddish. The four-part miniseries was created and written by Anna Winger and Alexa Karolinski, and directed by Maria Schrader.
The series received eight Primetime Emmy Award nominations, including Outstanding Limited Series, Outstanding Lead Actress in a Limited Series (Shira Haas), and Outstanding Writing for a Limited Series (Anna Winger), winning for Outstanding Directing for a Limited Series (Maria Schrader) - the first ever Primetime Emmy for a German production.

46.plot: 1986 年，切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸。科学家列加索夫、官员谢尔比纳和核物理学家霍缪克要在谎言已经发出去之后，把还没做完的灾难拦住。
46.plotEn: In 1986 the Chernobyl nuclear plant explodes. The scientist Legasov, the official Shcherbina, and the nuclear physicist Khomyuk have to stop a disaster that is not finished, after the lie has already gone out.
46.playbill: 五集迷你剧还原 1986 年核事故，从爆炸当夜一直讲到事后审判。最可怕的不是辐射画面，而是官僚系统怎样掩盖真相。氛围压抑，细节考究，豆瓣评分在 9 分以上。
46.playbillEn: A five-episode miniseries of the 1986 nuclear accident, from the night of the explosion through the hearings afterward. What is most frightening is not the images of radiation. It is how the bureaucracy covered up what had happened. The atmosphere is oppressive, the detail is careful, and the Douban score sits above 9.

47.plot: 这是一部由水岛新司同名棒球漫画改编，讲述万年吊车尾球队东京麦西的方方面面的动画，是一部以十几岁的少年为主要对象来企划的故事性很强的作品。
47.plotEn: The first female professional baseball player who strikes out sluggers with her magical pitch... The manager who makes every effort to amend the Baseball Regulations so that she can join the pros... The separated twin brothers who couldn't have met each other if they weren't both totally absorbed in baseball... This series describes the joys and distress, the glory and frustration of those who enthusiastically love baseball.

48.plot: 孤儿贝丝·哈蒙在收养家庭里靠镇静剂看见棋盘，然后在 1960 年代一路下到国际赛场。天才是真的，依赖、孤独和那套要她好看的世界也是真的。
48.plotEn: Beth Harmon, an orphan, sees the chessboard in the tranquilizers at her adoptive home, and then plays her way to international tournaments in the 1960s. The talent is real. So are the dependence, the loneliness, and a world that wants her to look good.
48.playbill: 孤儿院长大的女孩贝丝靠天赋成为国际象棋高手，同时与药物和酒精成瘾对抗。不懂下棋也能看懂，比赛拍得像体育片一样紧张。60 年代的服装美术很漂亮，七集就看完。
48.playbillEn: Beth, who grows up in an orphanage, becomes a chess champion on talent, and at the same time fights an addiction to drugs and alcohol. You can follow it without knowing chess. The matches are filmed with the tension of a sports movie. The 1960s clothes and design are beautiful. Seven episodes and it is done.

49.plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
49.plotEn: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
49.playbill: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
49.playbillEn: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

50.plot:
为什么老师会在这里!?——

不分场所地接连引发，由老师与男子高中生带来的紧张感满载的突发事件的连续。

充满大人魅力的老师们所展现的种种表情，了解得越多就越觉得可爱！

通过过激的情景描绘出来的“甜甜蜜蜜”而又“摇摇晃晃”的可爱老师们的高中生活！
50.plotEn: Ichiro Sato is about as average as a student can get... except for his above-average ability to land himself in totally awkward, intensely risqué situations with his no-nonsense teacher, Kana Kojima! Ichiro has his hands full dealing with these steamy shenanigans and unexpected encounters in the most unlikely places. At least it can’t get any worse, right?

51.plot: 1980 年代的印第安纳小镇，一个男孩失踪，朋友们拿着手电筒和一套桌面游戏的术语去找他。实验、另一侧的世界，和一位编号为十一的女孩连在一起。
51.plotEn: In an Indiana town in the 1980s, a boy disappears. His friends go looking for him with flashlights and the vocabulary of a tabletop game. An experiment, a world on the other side, and a girl numbered Eleven are connected.
51.playbill: 80 年代的美国小镇，一个男孩失踪，他的朋友们和一个有超能力的女孩一起去找他。满是《E.T.》、斯蒂芬·金和《龙与地下城》式的复古氛围。第一季最完整，后几季规模更大，适合全家一起追。
51.playbillEn: A boy disappears in an American town in the 1980s. His friends and a girl with powers go looking for him. It is full of the retro atmosphere of E.T., Stephen King, and Dungeons & Dragons. The first season is the most complete. The later seasons are bigger. It is easy to watch as a family.

52.plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
52.plotEn: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
52.playbill: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
52.playbillEn: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

53.plot:
《难以置信》是一部美国真实犯罪迷你剧，由托妮·科莱特、梅里特·韦弗和凯特琳·德弗主演。一名女子因报告自己被强奸而被指控犯罪，警方认为她捏造了自己的叙述，两名女侦探调查了一系列类似的袭击事件。该剧由苏珊娜·格兰特、阿耶莱特·沃尔德曼和迈克尔·查邦共同创作。所有三位联合创作者以及莎拉·汀伯曼、卡尔·贝弗利和凯蒂·库里克均担任执行制片人。该片于 2019 年 9 月 13 日在 Netflix 上发布。
该迷你剧改编自 2015 年 T. 克里斯蒂安·米勒 (T. Christian Miller) 和肯·阿姆斯特朗 (Ken Armstrong) 撰写的有关华盛顿和科罗拉多州连环强奸案的新闻文章《难以置信的强奸故事》。它还取材于他们 2018 年基于同一研究的书《虚假报告》。该剧获得了评论界的一致好评和无数荣誉，包括皮博迪奖以及影评人选择奖、金球奖和黄金时段艾美奖的最佳限定剧提名。所有三位女主角均获得影评人选择奖（科莱特获奖）和金球奖提名。科莱特还获得了黄金时段艾美奖和美国演员工会奖的提名。
53.plotEn:
Unbelievable is an American true crime drama miniseries starring Toni Collette, Merritt Wever, and Kaitlyn Dever. It follows a woman who was charged with a crime for reporting she was raped after police believe she fabricated her account, and two female detectives who investigate a spate of similar attacks. The show was co-created by Susannah Grant, Ayelet Waldman, and Michael Chabon. All three co-creators and Sarah Timberman, Carl Beverly, and Katie Couric were executive producers. It was released on September 13, 2019, on Netflix.
The miniseries is based on the 2015 news article "An Unbelievable Story of Rape", written by T. Christian Miller and Ken Armstrong about the Washington and Colorado serial rape cases. It also draws from their 2018 book A False Report, based on the same research. The series received critical acclaim and numerous accolades, including a Peabody Award and Best Limited Series nominations at the Critics' Choice, Golden Globes and Primetime Emmys. All three lead actresses were nominated at the Critics' Choice (Collette winning) and Golden Globe Awards. Collette also received nominations for the Primetime Emmy and SAG Award.

54.plot: 它不是漫画的逐格重拍。故事从 1921 年塔尔萨的种族屠杀开场，再落到一个蒙面警察仍在执勤的美国，雷吉娜·金饰演的安吉拉要查清父辈留下的身份。
54.plotEn: It is not a panel-by-panel remake of the comic. The story opens with the 1921 massacre in Tulsa and then settles in an America where masked police are still on duty. Angela, played by Regina King, has to find out the identity her father’s generation left her.
54.playbill: 不是电影版的翻拍，而是原著漫画的续集，故事放在 2019 年。它把超级英雄故事和美国的种族暴力史连在一起，开场就是 1921 年的塔尔萨种族屠杀。不看原著也能看，看过会更有收获。共获 11 项艾美奖。
54.playbillEn: It is not a remake of the film. It is a sequel to the original comic, set in 2019. It joins a superhero story to the history of racial violence in the United States. It opens with the 1921 Tulsa massacre. You can watch it without the comic. If you have read it, there is more. It won 11 Emmys.

55.plot: 在纽约市的暴力、另类现实中，种族骚乱、金融崩溃和犯罪浪潮汹涌袭来，非法夜总会的黑社会经济正在蓬勃发展。圣地亚哥侦探的任务是打击这些俱乐部。当圣地亚哥遇到新搭档埃弗雷特·莫尔时，他发现纽约市周围有众多政府机构和犯罪组织，争夺控制权。
55.plotEn: In a violent, alternate reality of New York City besieged by race riots, financial collapse, and a surging crime wave , an underworld economy of illegal nightclubs is thriving. Detective Santiago is tasked to crack down on these clubs. When he meets his new partner, Everett More, Santiago discovers there are numerous government agencies and crime organizations circling NYC and vying for control.

56.plot: 职业杀手巴里·伯克曼到洛杉矶执行任务，误入一堂表演课，决定自己也许可以成为演员。杀人的手艺和想被看见的欲望开始抢同一个日程。
56.plotEn: The hit man Barry Berkman comes to Los Angeles for a job, wanders into an acting class, and decides he might become an actor. The work of killing and the wish to be seen start competing for the same calendar.
56.playbill: 一名杀手来洛杉矶接活，误打误撞进了表演班，想转行当演员。开头是黑色喜剧，越往后越黑暗，接近犯罪悲剧。比尔·哈德尔既主演也执导，第二季的《罗尼/莉莉》一集非常出名。
56.playbillEn: A hit man comes to Los Angeles for a job, stumbles into an acting class, and tries to switch careers. It starts as a black comedy and gets darker, closer to a crime tragedy. Bill Hader stars and directs. The second-season episode “ronny/lily” is the famous one.

57.plot: Eve是个烦人的、聪明的、拿蓝领工资的英国军情五处特工，过去一直干文书工作，但这无法满足她的间谍梦。Villanelle是个高贵优雅、富有天赋的杀手，对暴力和暴力所能带来的奢华生活非常痴迷。两个女人都聪明绝顶，都对彼此充满好奇。在这场猫鼠游戏中，她们都想领先对手一步。
57.plotEn: A security consultant hunts for a ruthless assassin. Equally obsessed with each other, they go head to head in an epic game of cat-and-mouse.

58.plot: 深夜系列节目融合了真实纪录片、音乐表演、超现实主义情节剧和幽默动画，作为对当代美国媒体景观的意识流反应。
58.plotEn: Late-night series featuring a mix of vérité documentary, musical performances, surrealist melodrama and humorous animation as a stream-of-consciousness response to the contemporary American mediascape.

59.plot:
《宇宙小子》是卡通频道出品的电视动画剧集，由动画人丽贝卡·休格创作。

在《宇宙小子》的世界里，由一组宝石战士保护宇宙免遭邪恶力量的威胁。主人公小男孩史蒂文·宇宙继承了母亲的宝石力量，与其他三位宝石战士石榴、珍珠、紫晶一起生活。剧集围绕他们展开，讲述了史蒂文和三位宝石战士姐姐一起，在日常生活中拯救世界，以及探索自身神奇能力的成长故事。
59.plotEn: A young boy takes his mother's place in a group of gemstone-based beings, and must learn to control his powers.

60.plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
60.plotEn: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
60.playbill: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
60.playbillEn: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

62.plot: 埃莉诺死后醒来，发现自己进了一套按积分分配的来世，而档案显然搞错了人。邻居、道德哲学课和一位礼貌的建筑师，一起维持这个漂亮的社区。
62.plotEn: Eleanor wakes up dead and finds she has entered an afterlife assigned by points, and the file has clearly got the wrong person. The neighbors, a class in moral philosophy, and a polite architect keep this handsome neighborhood going.
62.playbill: 女主死后被误送进「善地」，只好偷偷学做好人，以免被发现。它把伦理学和哲学问题讲得轻松好懂。第一季结尾有个大反转，最好别被剧透。
62.playbillEn: The heroine dies and is sent by mistake to the Good Place, so she secretly learns how to be good before anyone notices. It explains ethics and philosophy lightly enough to follow. The end of the first season has a large reversal. Better not to have it spoiled.

63.plot: 该剧风格是真实罪案纪录片，但其实是讽刺题材。剧中指有人在高中向27名教师的汽车喷上JJ图案，在8集的第一季，一位有抱负的大二生兼记录片工作者Peter Maldanaldo（Tyler Alvarez饰），调查被指控犯下该恶作剧，在争议下被开除的高中四年级生Dylan Maxwell（Jimmy Tatro饰）。
63.plotEn: In the wake of their first documentary's success, Peter and Sam seek a new case and settle on a stomach-churning mystery at a Washington high school.

64.plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
64.plotEn: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
64.playbill: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
64.playbillEn: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

65.plot: 伊萨在洛杉矶的非营利机构上班，和最好的朋友莫莉一起应付恋爱、工作和一句说出来就会后悔的话。南洛杉矶不是背景板，是她们来回开的那条路。
65.plotEn: Issa works at a nonprofit in Los Angeles and, with her best friend Molly, deals with dating, work, and the sentence that will be regretted the moment it is said. South Los Angeles is not a backdrop. It is the road they drive back and forth.
65.playbill: 伊萨·雷讲洛杉矶黑人女性的恋爱、工作和友谊。最好看的不是爱情线，而是伊萨和莫莉之间互相依赖又常闹矛盾的闺蜜关系。配乐很出色，五季完结。
65.playbillEn: Issa Rae on the dating, the work, and the friendships of Black women in Los Angeles. What is best in it is not the romance. It is the friendship between Issa and Molly, who depend on each other and fight often. The music is excellent. Five seasons, and it ends.

66.plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
66.plotEn: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
66.playbill: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
66.playbillEn: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

67.plot: 在1958年的纽约，米琪麦瑟尔的生活很美好。她有丈夫和孩子，在他们的上西区公寓享受美好的赎罪日晚餐。但是当她的生活出乎意料地转变方向时，她必须快速决定她还擅长什么。所有人都认为从家庭主妇到脱口秀喜剧演员是疯狂的选择，但她不这么想。
67.plotEn: It’s 1958 Manhattan and Miriam “Midge” Maisel has everything she’s ever wanted - the perfect husband, kids, and Upper West Side apartment. But when her life suddenly takes a turn and Midge must start over, she discovers a previously unknown talent - one that will take her all the way from the comedy clubs of Greenwich Village to a spot on Johnny Carson’s couch.

68.plot: 厄恩辍学回到亚特兰大，替表兄、说唱歌手纸男孩管理刚起步的事业。城市、种族和名气在这里都不按常理出牌，有的集干脆走进另一个类型。
68.plotEn: Earn drops out and comes back to Atlanta to manage the early career of his cousin, the rapper Paper Boi. The city, race, and fame do not behave as expected here, and some episodes simply walk into another genre.
68.playbill: 表面讲穷小子给当说唱歌手的表弟做经纪人，实际每一集风格都可能不同：有时是荒诞喜剧，有时像恐怖片。它写美国黑人生活很独特，不说教，却处处刺人。第二季的《泰迪·珀金斯》一集尤其出名。
68.playbillEn: On the surface, a broke young man manages his cousin, a rapper. In practice each episode can be a different kind of show: sometimes an absurd comedy, sometimes something like a horror film. It writes Black life in America in its own way, without lectures, and it keeps pricking. The second-season episode “Teddy Perkins” is the one people single out.

69.plot: 约克郡警官凯瑟琳·考伍德管着一片并不幸福的谷地。害死女儿的汤米·李·罗伊斯出狱在即，而她正在抚养的外孙，是那段暴力留下的孩子。
69.plotEn: Catherine Cawood, a police officer in Yorkshire, is responsible for a valley that is not happy. Tommy Lee Royce, who caused her daughter’s death, is about to get out of prison. The grandson she is raising is the child that violence left behind.
69.playbill: 约克郡女警凯瑟琳查一宗绑架案时，发现嫌疑人正是当年侵犯她女儿、导致女儿自杀的那个男人。犯罪线很紧，人物关系也很痛。莎拉·兰开夏演的中年女警强硬、疲惫又有幽默感。三季共 18 集。
69.playbillEn: While investigating a kidnapping, the Yorkshire officer Catherine finds that the suspect is the man who assaulted her daughter and led to her daughter’s suicide. The crime plot is tight, and the relationships hurt. Sarah Lancashire’s middle-aged officer is hard, tired, and funny. Three seasons, eighteen episodes.

70.plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
70.plotEn: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
70.playbill: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
70.playbillEn: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

71.plot: Channel 4预定四集性丑闻剧集《国家淫才》（National Treasure）。该剧虚构一个国宝级人才，因为性侵而被指控。该剧以调查案件以及开庭审判为主线，探讨加害人与受害人的心理。该剧由Jack Thorne创作，定于明年播出。新闻稿指，该剧取材于真人真事。讲述Paul Finchley曾主演现象级喜剧，广受观众喜爱，尽管淡出荧屏很多年，依然会被群众认出，是一个演艺界的国宝人才。但是，突然被揭发自上世纪70年代开始性侵女性。除了Paul受到铺天盖地媒体报道以及警方深入调查而困扰，还有出庭指控现已50岁的受害者也受到了同样待遇。
71.plotEn: Paul Finchley is a bona fide "national treasure", one half of a popular, long-running comedy double act. The famous comedian's world is thrown into chaos when he is accused of historic sexual abuse.

72.plot: 塞琳娜·迈耶是美国副总统，日程全是没人想要的访问和随时会塌的联盟。她想当总统，幕僚想活命，每一集的危机都来自上一句随口的话。
72.plotEn: Selina Meyer is the vice president of the United States. The schedule is full of visits no one wants and alliances that can collapse at any moment. She wants to be president. The staff want to survive. Each episode’s crisis comes from the previous offhand sentence.
72.playbill: 美国副总统和她的幕僚永远在救火，政治在这里只剩甩锅、抢镜头和骂人。脏话写得极有创意，节奏快到要暂停回看。朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯凭此连拿六座艾美喜剧类女主角。
72.playbillEn: The vice president and her staff are always putting out fires. Politics here is only passing the blame, grabbing the camera, and swearing. The obscenities are extremely inventive, and the pace is fast enough that you will pause and go back. Julia Louis-Dreyfus won six Emmys for lead actress in a comedy for it.

73.plot: 德国83年是一部扣人心弦的电视剧，其故事反映的是80年代的德国政治斗争与真实现代战争之间的故事。该剧讲述的是一个土生土长在东德的24岁年轻人马丁·劳赫，被强制派往西德做民主德国国家安全局的秘密间谍。隐姓埋名于西德陆军之中，他必须搜集所有关于北约军事战略的机密。万事开头难，进展并非像他想象那样顺利，他所遇到的每一个人都深藏不可告人的秘密……
73.plotEn: A gripping coming-of-age story set against the real culture wars and political events of Germany in the 1980s. The drama follows Martin Rauch as the 24 year-old East Germany native is pulled from the world as he knows it and sent to the West as an undercover spy for the Stasi foreign service. Hiding in plain sight in the West German army, he must gather the secrets of NATO military strategy. Everything is new, nothing is quite what it seems and everyone he encounters is harboring secrets, both political and personal.

74.plot: 改编自 Mairi Hedderwick 广受喜爱的系列书籍，凯蒂·莫拉格是一个红发小女孩，与家人住在遥远而美丽的苏格兰虚构岛屿斯特鲁伊。尽管她生活在一个相当独特的环境中，但她的冒险充满了所有孩子都能认识和认同的经历和感受。她的故事充满了嫉妒、勇敢和竞争——周围有一个烦人的弟弟、忙碌的店主父母、一个完美的好朋友和一对无所不知的祖母。这些故事颂扬了社区的内在意识、环境的珍贵以及家庭生活中普遍存在的紧张和欢乐。凯蒂·莫拉格（Katie Morag）是一个精力充沛的角色，众所周知，她经常陷入困境，但通常会以一种有趣而可爱的方式摆脱困境（通常是在她的一位或另一位祖母的帮助下）。
74.plotEn: Based on the much-loved series of books by Mairi Hedderwick, Katie Morag is a small red-headed girl who lives with her family on the remote and beautiful fictional Scottish island of Struay. Although she lives in a fairly unique setting, her adventures are full of experiences and feelings that all children can recognize and identify with. Her stories are full of jealousy, bravery and rivalry – surrounded by an annoying little brother, busy shopkeeper parents, a perfectly perfect best friend and a couple of grandmothers who between them know everything about everything. The stories celebrate the intrinsic sense of community, the preciousness of the environment and the universal tensions and joys of family life. Katie Morag is a feisty character who has been known to get herself into scrapes but who generally emerges from them (usually with some assistance from one or other of her Grandmothers) in a funny and endearing way.

75.plot: 自从短暂的超级英雄生涯悲剧收场后，杰西卡·琼斯成为了纽约地狱厨房地区暴躁、尖刻的私家侦探，开始重塑自己的生活和事业。但由于深受严重的创伤后应激障碍的影响，杰西卡需要对抗外压、战胜心魔，必要时还得用到她那非凡的能力……尤其当她的生命受到威胁时。
75.plotEn: After a tragic ending to her short-lived super hero stint, Jessica Jones is rebuilding her personal life and career as a detective who gets pulled into cases involving people with extraordinary abilities in New York City.

76.plot: 根据Aziz Ansari单元演员生活经历改编。纽约一名年届三十的演员Dev，连自己下一顿要吃什么都无法决定，更不用说接下来的人生路要如何抉择。故事将会探讨多样话题，从老年人困境到移民经历到如何寻找晚餐最好吃的意面。
76.plotEn: 30-year-old New York actor Dev takes on such pillars of maturity as the first big job, a serious relationship, and busting sex offenders on the subway.

77.plot: 本剧的主角为艾略特·奥尔德森 (Elliot Alderson)，他居住在纽约市，是一名网络安全工程师。晚上，他化身为一名黑客。艾略特患有社交恐惧症。艾略特遇见了一个神秘的无政府主义者，他名为机器人先生 (Mr. Robot) 。机器人先生招募艾略特加入他的黑客组织“反社会 (fsociety)”。艾略特感到好奇，但他并没有确定是否要加入这个黑客组织。机器人先生让艾略特暗中摧毁雇佣艾略特的公司。艾略特对此跨国集团反感，但秉持良心公义，他不想伤害无辜，所以仍然一次又一次抗拒去彻底揭发对世界有巨大影响力的这个集团。
77.plotEn: A young programmer, Elliot, suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot finds himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.

78.plot: 全世界百分之二的人忽然消失，没有解释。三年后，小镇上的人用邪教、职务和沉默继续生活，警察加维只想让这一天不要再裂开。
78.plotEn: Two percent of the world’s people vanish at once, with no explanation. Three years later, the people in a small town go on living by means of cults, jobs, and silence. The police officer Garvey only wants the day not to split open again.
78.playbill: 全球 2% 的人突然消失，剧集不解释原因，只关心留下来的人怎样面对失去。第一季偏压抑；第二季换到新小镇后渐入佳境；第三季结局非常动人。适合能接受慢节奏和开放问题的观众。
78.playbillEn: Two percent of the people on earth disappear at once. The show does not explain why. It only cares how the people who remain face the loss. The first season is on the oppressive side. The second, after a move to a new town, finds its feet. The third season’s ending is very moving. It suits someone who can take a slow pace and questions left open.

79.plot: 摩特是一名德高望重的大学教授，虽然他和妻子雪梨已经离婚多年，但两人之间还是维持着非常友好的来往。摩特有三个孩子，大女儿沙拉家庭美满婚姻幸福，但实际上，她一直都没有忘记过自己在大学时代交往过的前女友。二儿子乔什是乐队经纪人，感情生活一片混乱的他和自己乐队的主唱有着不清不楚的暧昧关系。小女儿艾力看似是三姐弟里最正常的一个人，但她也隐瞒着自己的秘密。一天，摩特告诉了自己的孩子们一个惊人的消息，他宣布自己一直以来都是一名跨性别者，自我认知性别为女性。
79.plotEn: An LA family with serious boundary issues have their past and future unravel when a dramatic admission causes everyone's secrets to spill out.

80.plot: 蕾切尔是该节目的年轻女雇员，她唯一的工作就是操纵参赛者之间的关系（参赛者的相互关系及参赛者和她的关系），人为地制造戏剧性和节目制作人奎恩需要的“吸引眼球的镜头”。单身汉亚当是《天长地久》节目的核心，他是王位继承人，既富有又有权势，而且非常英俊，参赛的女人们争相抢夺他的宠爱。而他之所以答应参加该节目，一方面是是为了满足家人的期望并振兴自己的王国，另一方面是为了消除自己过去坏男孩的名声。毫无疑问，多数参赛的女人是冲着金钱和名誉来的，但亚当却对他们丝毫不理，反而与蕾切尔之间发生了说不清的情愫……
80.plotEn: Set against the backdrop of a hit dating competition show, Rachel is a young staffer whose sole job is to manipulate her relationships with and among the contestants to get the vital dramatic and outrageous footage the program's dispassionate executive producer demands.

81.plot: 根据两届布克奖得主希拉里·曼特尔（Hilary Mantel）的热销历史小说《狼厅》Wolf Hall和《提堂》Bring Up the Bodies改编，讲述了亨利八世统治下的都铎王朝宫廷权力斗争的故事。
81.plotEn: England in the 1520s is a heartbeat from disaster. If the King dies without a male heir, the country could be destroyed by civil war. Henry VIII wants to annul his marriage of twenty years and marry Anne Boleyn. The Pope and most of Europe oppose him. Into this impasse steps Thomas Cromwell: a wholly original man, a charmer, and a bully, both idealist and opportunist, astute in reading people, and implacable in his ambition. But Henry is volatile: one day tender, one day murderous. Cromwell helps him break the opposition, but what will be the price of his triumph?

82.plot: 主人公是一个中上阶层的黑人（Anthony Anderson），他试图依靠自己保留的「文化特性」来抚育子女，但却在各方面遭遇障碍：开明大方的妻子（Tracee Ellis Ross），因循守旧的父亲，还有被时代「同化」的孩子们全都反对他。
82.plotEn: A family man struggles to gain a sense of cultural identity while raising his kids in a predominantly white, upper-middle-class neighborhood.

83.plot: 每一集都是一个邻近的未来：记忆可以重播，社交可以打分，意识可以拷进另一具身体。技术很少是唯一的反派，使用它的欲望才是。
83.plotEn: Each episode is a near future: memory can be replayed, social life can be scored, a mind can be copied into another body. The technology is rarely the only villain. The desire to use it is.
83.playbill: 单元剧，每集一个近未来科技故事：社交评分、记忆回放、意识上传，技术总在放大人性的弱点。不用按顺序看，可以先挑《圣朱尼佩洛》《白熊》《急转直下》这些口碑集。前三季整体最稳。
83.playbillEn: An anthology. Each episode is a near-future technology story: social scores, memory playback, uploading a mind. The technology magnifies a weakness in people. You do not have to watch in order. Start with the well-liked ones: “San Junipero,” “White Bear,” and “Nosedive.” The first three seasons are the steadiest.

84.plot: 《冰血暴》是一部于2014年4月15日在FX首播的黑色幽默犯罪诗选剧。本剧取材自科恩兄弟1996年执导的同名电影，并由诺亚·霍利开创。
84.plotEn: A close-knit anthology series dealing with stories involving malice, violence and murder based in and around Minnesota.

85.plot:
《艾米·舒默的内心》是一部由艾米·舒默创作并主持的美国喜剧喜剧电视连续剧。该剧于 2013 年 4 月 30 日至 2016 年 6 月 16 日在 Comedy Central 播出，并于 2022 年在 Paramount+ 重播第五季。舒默和丹尼尔·鲍威尔担任该剧的执行制片人。该剧获得了皮博迪奖，并获得了八项黄金时段艾美奖提名，并赢得了三项。
《艾米·舒默内心》第二季于 2014 年 6 月 3 日完结，一周后续订第三季。第三季于2015年4月21日首播，并于同日订购第四季，并于一年后的2016年4月21日首播。2016年1月6日，该剧续订第五季。 2016年8月，尽管早些时候宣布续订，但仍有人猜测该剧已被取消。舒默通过社交媒体否认了这些报道，称该剧的制作正在中断，而她则专注于巡演。不过，她也表示自己“不再出演这个节目”。据《纽约时报》2019 年 3 月的采访称，舒默签订了制作该剧另一季的合同，这导致该剧最终回归。
氧
85.plotEn:
Inside Amy Schumer is an American sketch comedy television series created and hosted by Amy Schumer. The series aired on Comedy Central from April 30, 2013, to June 16, 2016, and was revived in 2022 for a fifth season on Paramount+. Schumer and Daniel Powell served as the show's executive producers. The show received a Peabody Award and has been nominated for eight Primetime Emmy Awards, winning three.
Inside Amy Schumer completed its second season on June 3, 2014, and was renewed for a third season a week later. The third season premiered on April 21, 2015, with a fourth season ordered the same day, which premiered one year later on April 21, 2016. On January 6, 2016, the show was renewed for a fifth season. In August 2016, there was speculation though that the show had been cancelled despite the earlier announcement of renewal. Schumer denied the reports via social media, stating that production of the show was going on hiatus while she focused on touring. However, she also stated that she was "not making the show anymore". According to a March 2019 interview by The New York Times, Schumer was under contract to produce another season of the show, leading to its eventual return.
On February 24, 2021, it was announced that the show would be revived with five specials by Paramount+. On September 20, 2022, it was reported that the five installments were no longer called specials but instead would be the five episodes of the fifth season: two episodes debuting on October 20, with the rest released weekly. The series was canceled on June 26, 2023, and removed from Paramount+, while plans to air the fifth season were subsequently dropped on Comedy Central. The complete series library was acquired by Hulu.

86.plot: 氰化欢乐秀（The Cyanide & Happiness Show）是一部国外制作的搞笑同人动画短片。氰化欢乐秀专业开脑洞，让你的生活乐起来~！
86.plotEn: Following the success of its webcomic and occasional animated shorts, Cyanide & Happiness has debuted its animated show. After a very successful Kickstarter campaign, the creators of the popular comic (Kris Wilson, Rob DenBleyker, Matt Melvin, Dave McElfatrick) have released a much longer show that’s essentially a collection of animated sketches with some recurring themes throughout.

87.plot:
阿比盖尔·利·斯宾塞（Abigail Leigh Spencer，1981 年 8 月 4 日出生）是一位美国女演员、制片人和作家。她的职业生涯始于在 ABC 日间电视肥皂剧《All My Children》（1999-2001 年）中扮演 Rebecca Tyree（丽贝卡·泰里），之后又出演了终身犯罪剧《Angela's Eyes》（2006 年）。 2013年至2016年，斯宾塞在圣丹斯电视连续剧《纠正》中饰演阿曼莎·霍尔顿，并因此获得评论家选择电视奖提名；随后，她在 NBC 科幻剧集《Timeless》中饰演历史学教授露西·普雷斯顿 (Lucy Preston)。截至 2026 年，她在福克斯电视台剧集《最佳医学》中担任主角。
斯宾塞出演过许多电影，包括《在我的睡梦中》(2010)、《牛仔与外星人》(2011)、《这意味着战争》(2012)、《追逐小牛》(2012)、《康涅狄格鬼魂 2：乔治亚的幽灵》(2013)、《绿野仙踪》(2013) 和《这就是我离开你的地方》(2014)。她还在电视剧《广告狂人》（2009）、《霍桑》（2009-2011）、《金装律师》（2011-2019）和《实习医生格蕾》（2017-2022）中反复出演角色。
87.plotEn:
Abigail Leigh Spencer (born August 4, 1981) is an American actress, producer, and writer. She began her career playing Rebecca Tyree on the ABC daytime television soap opera All My Children (1999–2001) before going on to star in the Lifetime crime drama series Angela's Eyes (2006). From 2013 to 2016, Spencer starred as Amantha Holden in the SundanceTV drama series Rectify, for which she received a nomination for a Critics' Choice Television Award; she then starred as history professor Lucy Preston in the NBC science-fiction series Timeless. As of 2026, she is in a lead role on the FOX series Best Medicine.
Spencer has appeared in many films, including In My Sleep (2010), Cowboys & Aliens (2011), This Means War (2012), Chasing Mavericks (2012), The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia (2013), Oz the Great and Powerful (2013), and This Is Where I Leave You (2014). She also had recurring roles on the series Mad Men (2009), Hawthorne (2009–2011), Suits (2011–2019), and Grey's Anatomy (2017–2022).

88.plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
88.plotEn: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
88.playbill: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
88.playbillEn: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

89.plot: 《探索未知》是由Ping Pong Productions制作的美国真人实境电视连续剧，紧接着是探险家兼电视节目主持人乔什·盖茨（Josh Gates）在调查谜团和传奇故事之后。该系列于2015年1月8日首播，最初在旅游频道播出，然后在2018年移至探索频道。
89.plotEn: The adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates unsolved iconic stories across the globe.

90.plot: 20世纪初，抗生素尚未发现，一场外科手术就有可能让人丧命，萨克雷医生就是在这种环境下不断挑战医疗边界。片中的血腥场面是家常便饭，让观众可以直击当年的医疗现实。
90.plotEn: Set in downtown New York in 1900, 'The Knick' is centered on the Knickerbocker Hospital and its staff, notably Dr. John Thackery, the hospital's brilliant chief surgeon who pushes medicine's boundaries, pioneering new procedures despite a severe drug addiction.

91.plot:
McKinley高中合唱团曾有过辉煌的过去，但随着岁月的流逝，早已灰暗。教师Will（马修·莫里森 Matthew Morrison 饰）接受了艰巨任务：重塑合唱团形象。但摆在面前的现实是：校啦啦队教练Sue（简·林奇 Jane Lynch 饰）的万般阻挠。来参加的学生五花八门。男高音Kurt（克里斯·柯尔弗 Chris Colfer 饰）有表现力但愚笨；见习主唱不肯唱背景和声；吉他手总失踪。Will把希望寄托在Rachel（丽亚·米雪儿 Lea Michele 饰）和Finn（柯瑞·蒙特斯 Cory Monteith 饰）身上。但他的女友Quinn（迪安娜·阿格隆 Dianna Agron 饰）和橄榄球队队友Puck（马克·塞灵 Mark Salling 饰）却总给他惹麻烦。 

Will能够坚持自己的梦想和孩子们一起走下去吗？
91.plotEn: In this musical comedy, optimistic high school teacher Will Schuester tries to refuel his own passion while reinventing the high school's glee club and challenging a group of outcasts to realize their star potential as they strive to outshine their singing competition while navigating the cruel halls of McKinley High.

92.plot:
主角是一位勇敢多智的非洲女性，在当地开设了一家侦探社，成为当地独一无二的女侦探，解决了无数大小人物的生活烦恼。没有流血，没有冷酷的犯罪案件，其特色并不在展现诡异的奇案，而是一些与生活习习相关的困扰－－例如为人寻找失踪丈夫，揭发一个骗子的真面目，找寻一个叛逆女儿的下落，追查一位疑似被巫师抓去炼制补药的小男孩－－而在解决问题的过程中，展现了人性的关怀及温暖。它有的是到处可见的小机智，及充满非洲人情味及趣味的生活意趣。

在叙述这些温馨侦探故事的同时，很自然地带领观众认识一个非刻板印象中的非洲－－这个非洲展现的不是战争、饥饿、绝望，而是其美好的质朴传统及代代相传的生存毅力，全剧充满醇厚的生命情怀。
92.plotEn: The adventures of Mma Ramotswe, a Motswana woman who starts Botswana's first female-owned detective agency.

93.plot: 英格兰西南部的多塞特郡一个安宁的海滨小镇，警察来到这个原本安宁的小镇调查一个年仅11岁的男孩丹尼神秘死亡的悲剧，之后又经历了对凶手的审判、旧案重提，以及丹尼谋杀案三年后的小镇发生的案件，每个人的生活都发生了翻天覆地的变化……
93.plotEn: The murder of a young boy in a small coastal town brings a media frenzy, which threatens to tear the community apart.

94.plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
94.plotEn: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
94.playbill: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
94.playbillEn: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

95.plot: 本剧呈现黑手党生活、美国家庭、意裔美国人社群、暴力支配的世界与道德的灰色地带。由詹姆士·甘多费尼（James Gandolfini）、萝兰·布雷柯（Lorraine Bracco）、艾迪·法柯（Edie Falco）及麦克·英普雷欧里（Michael Imperioli）领衔主演。剧情的主线围绕在东尼·沙普蓝诺（甘多费尼饰）的家庭与自己所领导的犯罪组织的各式矛盾与冲突。
95.plotEn: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. The show features Tony's family members and Mafia associates in prominent roles and story arcs, most notably his wife Carmela and his cousin and protégé Christopher Moltisanti.

96.plot: 宾夕法尼亚一家纸业公司的斯克兰顿分公司，经理迈克尔·斯科特把办公室当成自己的舞台。假纪录片拍下销售、恋爱，以及谁都不想参加的派对。
96.plotEn: At the Scranton branch of a paper company in Pennsylvania, the manager Michael Scott treats the office as his stage. A fake documentary records the sales, the romances, and the parties no one wants to attend.
96.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍一家纸业公司的日常，老板迈克尔每次想当好人都会搞砸。吉姆和帕姆的感情线是很多人坚持看下去的原因。第一季还在模仿英版，从第二季开始找到自己的风格，前七季最好。
96.playbillEn: A mockumentary of daily life at a paper company. Every time the boss, Michael, tries to be a good person, he wrecks it. Jim and Pam’s relationship is the reason a lot of people stay. The first season is still imitating the British original. From the second season it finds its own style. The first seven seasons are the best.

97.plot: 一架客机坠毁在热带岛屿，幸存者很快发现这里不是普通的荒岛。每一集用倒叙打开一个人的过去，岛上的谜则越开越多。
97.plotEn: A passenger plane crashes on a tropical island, and the survivors soon find it is not an ordinary deserted island. Each episode opens someone’s past in flashback. The mysteries on the island keep multiplying.
97.playbill: 飞机坠毁在神秘海岛，幸存者遇到越来越多怪事。每集穿插一个人的过去，人物塑造很扎实，也带起了悬疑美剧层层埋坑的风潮。前几季极其上头，结局争议很大。
97.playbillEn: A plane crashes on a mysterious island, and the survivors meet stranger and stranger things. Each episode cuts in someone’s past. The people are solidly built, and the show started the fashion for mystery series that keep burying clues. The early seasons are extremely addictive. The ending was heavily argued over.

98.plot: 地产商乔治·布卢斯被捕后，儿子迈克尔试图拉住这个不断内斗的家族。旁白补上他们不肯承认的那半句，笑话常常要到后面几集才收回来。
98.plotEn: After the developer George Bluth is arrested, his son Michael tries to hold together a family that keeps turning on itself. The narrator supplies the half of the sentence they will not admit, and the jokes are often paid off several episodes later.
98.playbill: 富豪老爸被捕后，只有二儿子迈克尔想撑住这个家，其他人都在添乱。这是最需要专心看的喜剧之一，伏笔和梗会隔好几集甚至好几季才回收。前三季是经典；Netflix 复活的第四、五季口碑差一些。
98.playbillEn: After the rich father is arrested, only the second son, Michael, tries to keep the family standing. Everyone else makes it worse. It is one of the comedies you have to watch closely: setups come back episodes, or seasons, later. The first three seasons are the classic run. The fourth and fifth, revived by Netflix, were received less well.

99.plot: 巴尔的摩的缉毒组盯上毒贩斯特林格·贝尔和奥马尔。五季分别走过街头、码头、市政厅、学校和报社，警察只是这座城市的其中一条线。
99.plotEn: A narcotics unit in Baltimore sets its sights on the dealer Stringer Bell and on Omar. Five seasons pass through the street, the docks, city hall, the schools, and the newspaper. The police are only one line in the city.
99.playbill: 不是一案一结的警匪剧。五季分别拍毒品街头、码头工会、市政选举、公立学校和报社，拼起来是一整座城市怎样失灵。主创西蒙当过巴尔的摩记者，很多细节来自真实案例。开头人物多、俚语多，撑过前三四集就会上瘾。
99.playbillEn: It is not a cop show that closes a case each week. Five seasons cover the drug corners, the dockworkers’ union, a city election, the public schools, and a newspaper. Put together, they are how a whole city fails. The creator, Simon, was a reporter in Baltimore, and a lot of the detail comes from real cases. There are many people at the start, and a lot of slang. Get through the first three or four episodes and it takes hold.

100.plot: 费舍尔家在洛杉矶经营殡仪馆。每一集以一次死亡开场，活着的人则继续吵架、相爱和把遗体推进房间。
100.plotEn: The Fisher family runs a funeral home in Los Angeles. Each episode opens with a death. The living go on arguing, loving, and wheeling the body into the room.
100.playbill: 一家人经营殡仪馆，每集开头都会死一个人，死亡成了日常话题。它真正讲的是活着的人怎样面对失去、性取向和家庭关系。最后几分钟的蒙太奇，被公认为电视剧史上最好的结局之一。
100.playbillEn: A family runs a funeral home. Someone dies at the start of each episode, and death becomes an ordinary subject. What it is really about is how the living face loss, sexuality, and the family. The montage in the last few minutes is widely taken as one of the best endings in the history of television.

101.plot: 根据斯蒂芬·安布罗斯的记述，跟随美军第 101 空降师 E 连，从佐治亚的训练营走到诺曼底、阿登森林和德军的鹰巢。一连人在减员里重新认识彼此。
101.plotEn: Following Stephen Ambrose’s account, it stays with Easy Company of the 101st Airborne, from training camp in Georgia to Normandy, the Ardennes, and Hitler’s Eagle’s Nest. The company gets to know itself again as the numbers drop.
101.playbill: 汉克斯和斯皮尔伯格监制，跟着二战美军 101 空降师 E 连从训练一直走到战争结束。每集开头有真实老兵的采访，战争场面真实、残酷。第六集《巴斯托涅》和第九集《我们为何而战》尤其让人难忘。
101.playbillEn: Produced by Hanks and Spielberg, it follows Easy Company of the 101st Airborne from training through the end of the Second World War. Each episode opens with interviews with the real veterans. The fighting is plain and brutal. “Bastogne” and “Why We Fight” are the episodes people remember.

104.plot: 这是发生在美国芝加哥一家急诊室的故事，这里每天收治的都是需要急救的病人，每位医护人员都用自己的高超的医术和仁慈的爱心对每一位患者进行救助，每天有很多人从这里健康地走出，也有很多生命在这里画上句号，但是弥漫在急诊室里的温暖感受人的空气，却一直没有变过……健康与病痛相连，生命与死亡并存，这部剧集讲述发生在急诊室里真实而又感人的故事。
104.plotEn: ER explores the inner workings of an urban teaching hospital and the critical issues faced by the dedicated physicians and staff of its overburdened emergency room.

105.plot:
《我会飞走》是一部美剧电视连续剧，以 20 世纪 50 年代末和 1960 年代初为背景，发生在美国南部一个未指定的州。该剧于 1991 年至 1993 年在 NBC 播出，由雷吉娜·泰勒 (Regina Taylor) 饰演莉莉·哈珀 (Lilly Harper)，她是地区检察官福雷斯特·贝德福德 (Forrest Bedford) 家族的黑人管家，其名字讽刺地引用了三K党创始人内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特 (Nathan Bedford Forrest)。随着节目的进展，莉莉越来越多地参与民权运动，最终事件也牵涉到福雷斯特。

《我会飞走》赢得了 1992 年两项艾美奖，并总共获得 23 项提名。它获得了三项人道奖、两项金球奖、两项全国有色人种协进会形象奖杰出剧集奖和一项皮博迪奖。然而，该剧从未成为收视率大片，尽管遭到评论家和观众组织的广泛抗议，但 NBC 仍于 1993 年取消了该剧。

该节目取消后，制作了一部时长两小时的电影《我要飞走了：过去和现在》，以解决第二季中悬而未决的故事情节，并为该剧提供一个真正的结局。这部电影于 1993 年 10 月 11 日在 PBS 上播出。它的主要故事情节与 1955 年埃米特·蒂尔被谋杀的真实故事非常相似。
105.plotEn:
I'll Fly Away is an American drama television series set during the late 1950s and early 1960s, in an unspecified Southern U.S. state. It aired on NBC from 1991 to 1993 and starred Regina Taylor as Lilly Harper, a black housekeeper for the family of district attorney Forrest Bedford, whose name is an ironic reference to Nathan Bedford Forrest, the founder of the Ku Klux Klan. As the show progressed, Lilly became increasingly involved in the Civil Rights Movement, with events eventually drawing in Forrest as well.

I'll Fly Away won two 1992 Emmy Awards, and 23 nominations in total. It won three Humanitas Prizes, two Golden Globe Awards, two NAACP Image Awards for Outstanding Drama Series, and a Peabody Award. However, the series was never a ratings blockbuster, and it was canceled by NBC in 1993, despite widespread protests by critics and viewer organizations.

After the program's cancellation, a two-hour movie, I'll Fly Away: Then and Now, was produced, in order to resolve dangling storylines from Season 2, and provide the series with a true finale. The movie aired on October 11, 1993 on PBS. Its major storyline closely paralleled the true story of the 1955 murder of Emmett Till in Money, Mississippi. Thereafter, PBS began airing repeats of the original episodes, ceasing after one complete showing of the entire series.

106.plot: 抗战初期，外国留学生方鸿渐（陈道明饰）回到了祖国。方鸿渐其实是在国外混了几年，一个学位没取得，最后没法才买了个学位归国的。出身封建家庭的鸿渐家里早给他订了亲，只是未婚妻没来得及和他结婚就逝世了。鸿渐回国后一直居住在丈人的家里，丈人颇有些能耐，为他谋了一份不错的职业。女博士苏文纨一直对鸿渐有好感，而鸿渐迷恋的却是在苏小姐家里第一次拜访认识的唐小姐。随后，鸿渐与唐小姐渐渐打得火热，然而丈人家看出了他和唐小姐的往来，渐渐冷落了他，而后鸿渐和唐小姐亦因误会而结束。 失恋后的鸿渐和当时同样追求苏小姐失败的留学生赵辛楣（英达饰）成了莫逆，二人同时受到了内地的三闾大学的聘请。于是两位好友一起上路了，前往三闾大学去开展他们的新生活。
106.plotEn: Set in the 1930s, “Fortress Besieged” follows the misadventures of Fang Hung-chien, a bumbling everyman who wastes his time studying abroad, and secures a fake degree when learning he has run out of money and must return home to China. Fang was the son of a country gentleman. A marriage had been arranged for him while at university, but the intended wife died before he could see her.

107.plot: 在第二次世界大战中英国统治的最后几年，印度因强奸而被不公正逮捕，引发了在战争和个人阴谋背景下探讨身份和个人责任的问题。
107.plotEn: In India, during the final years of British rule in World War II, an unjust arrest for rape sets off questions of identity and personal responsibility being explored against a background of war and personal intrigue.

108.plot: 1935 年，德国柏林。犹太画家卡尔-魏斯（Karl Weiss）和女基督徒英格-赫尔姆斯（Inga Helms）结婚的那一天，他们和魏斯全家都被卷入了纳粹政权的漩涡、第二次世界大战的风暴以及罪恶的 “最终解决方案”、大屠杀、纳粹浩劫的恐怖之中；而雄心勃勃的律师埃里克-多夫（Erik Dorf）则在阴险的莱因哈特-海德里希（Reinhard Heydrich）手中堕入地狱。
108.plotEn: Berlin, Germany, 1935. The day Karl Weiss, a Jewish painter, and Inga Helms, a Christian woman, marry, is the one in which both of them and the entire Weiss family are caught up in the maelstrom of the Nazi regime, the storms of World War II and the horrors of the criminal Final Solution, the Holocaust, the Shoah; while Erik Dorf, an ambitious lawyer, undertakes his fall into hell at the hands of the sinister Reinhard Heydrich.

109.plot: 一名前电视台经理转为报纸城市编辑及其记者人员的审判。
109.plotEn: The trials of a former television station manager turned newspaper city editor, and his journalist staff.

110.plot: 第4077机动部队外科医院陷于朝鲜战争中期。在他们所处环境的帮助下，他们不得不自娱自乐。医生、护士、管理人员和士兵喜欢恶作剧和复仇，他们经常想方设法让战时生活变得可以忍受。
110.plotEn: The 4077th Mobile Army Surgical Hospital is stuck in the middle of the Korean war. With little help from the circumstances they find themselves in, they are forced to make their own fun. Fond of practical jokes and revenge, the doctors, nurses, administrators, and soldiers often find ways of making wartime life bearable.
